descriptionMarkdown:
Discipline Feature
Biomancer Once per long rest, when a creature you can touch 
drops to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead.
Telekine Once per short rest, when you use Psychic Ward, 
you may also push the attacker 10 ft.
Diviner Once per long rest, replace a d20 roll made by a 
creature you can see with a 10 before modifiers.
Pyromancer Once per short rest, your Pyromancy power 
ignores fire resistance.
Malefic-Touched
Once per long rest, after triggering Perils, you may 
choose to gain 1 Corruption to treat the Perils result 
as Warp Static.
Blank / Null-
Bound
Once per long rest, when a creature within 60 ft 
triggers Perils, you may force it to reroll the Perils 
severity roll and use the lower result if it is an ally, 
or the higher result if it is hostile.
